name: tia_plug_module
description: Create and plug a module or submodule (HardwareObject.PlugNew) into a device or device item at a position, e.g. a signal module into 'Rail_0' or a PROFINET telegram/GSD submodule into a drive's head module. Checks CanPlugNew first; dry_run=true (default) stops after the check.

device_name.description: Exact device (station) name as listed by tia_list_devices, e.g. 'PLC_1' or 'ACS480_1'.

parent_item_path.description: Item to plug into (e.g. 'Rail_0' for an S7-1200 rack, or the GSD head module). Omit for the device itself.

type_identifier.description: Complete type identifier of the module/submodule.

name.description: Name for the new item; must be unique in its container.
